contracts.source: Jacobs Solutions press release: Jacobs awarded EPCM contract to deliver second Hut 8 AI data (05-12-2026)
contracts.signal: Jacobs was awarded a sole-source engineering, procurement and construction management (EPCM) contract by Hut 8 to deliver Beacon Point, Hut 8's second AI data center campus (Nueces County, Texas; multi-phase, designed for one gigawatt of total capacity), a follow-on to Jacobs' EPCM role at River Bend; initial energization and commissioning targeted for 2027. Hut 8 CEO Asher Genoot: 'the second time we have selected Jacobs as EPCM lead'.
